name: io.github.chrischall/warapp-mcp
description: war.app (Warzone) game advisor — games, maps, bonuses, routes, live board, picks, turns and chat

environmentVariables.name: WARAPP_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: The email address you sign in to war.app with.

environmentVariables.name: WARAPP_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your war.app API token, from https://war.app/API/GetAPIToken while signed in.

environmentVariables.name: WARAPP_WS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: fetchproxy bridge concentrator port for the live-game tools. Defaults to the fleet-shared 37149.

environmentVariables.name: WARAPP_ENV_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional dotenv file with WARAPP_EMAIL / WARAPP_API_TOKEN (default ~/.config/warapp-mcp/.env)

environmentVariables.name: WARAPP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: How the live-game tools reach war.app: auto (default, direct when a session is linked else the browser bridge), direct, or fetchproxy.

environmentVariables.name: WARAPP_SESSION_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Where the linked direct-transport session is stored (default <data dir>/session.json). Local-only, file mode 0600.

environmentVariables.name: WARAPP_PLAYER_RECORD
environmentVariables.description: The name-free cross-game record of how other players kept truces (salted hashes, no names). On by default; set off to turn it off.

environmentVariables.name: WARAPP_PLAYER_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Opponent profiling: counts of what each opponent did on the turns your boards showed (gameplay only, no names or chat), kept per game, and folded name-free (salted-hash keys) into counts across finished games. On by default; set off to turn it off.

environmentVariables.name: WARAPP_CHAT_AUTOMATION
environmentVariables.description: Whether an agent may send chat replies the owner did not ask for. Off by default (chat is read, labelled and advised on; the owner sends every reply); set on to let the advice offer the exact send, which still needs confirming.

environmentVariables.name: WARAPP_CHAT_BLOCKS_TURN
environmentVariables.description: Whether unread chat that may change the turn (a truce message from a partner, a threat from a neighbour, a surrender awaiting acceptance, a teammate asking about this turn) stops a turn submission until it is read. Off by default (the submit preview only warns); set on to refuse until the messages are marked seen or the submit says chat_reviewed.

environmentVariables.name: WARAPP_TIMEZONE
environmentVariables.description: An IANA time zone name (e.g. America/New_York). When set, every timestamp in a tool's answer gains a sibling in that zone (time -> localTime, e.g. "Tue 24 Nov, 6:14 am EST"); the UTC fields are unchanged. Unset or invalid: UTC only.

environmentVariables.name: WARAPP_DECISION_LOG
environmentVariables.description: A per-game log of each turn's view, the plan, the orders sent and, once the game ends, the true figures (player ids and numbers, no names or chat), for offline review and replay. On by default; set off to turn it off, or full to keep every turn uncompacted.
